set4_cond_squad_use_ex_desc: When any squad member uses an <ct color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</ct>, the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 45 for 8s.
set4_cond_not_char_use_ex_desc: If the character using the <ct color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</ct> is not the equipper, the equipper's <ct color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</ct> is increased by 25%.
